title: Faster IQ4_XS MMQ prefill on gfx1100 (bit-identical)
task: Prefill of Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL (llama-bench pp4096, the factory profile qwen-plain, metric pp_tps) on an RX 7900 XTX (gfx1100, RDNA3, int8 WMMA) runs the quantized matrix multiplication kernels (MMQ). IQ4_XS holds about 23 % of the weight parameters (IQ4_XS tensors) of this model. Make the IQ4_XS MMQ path faster in prefill with bit-identical outputs, behind an env switch whose off value restores the old kernels. Relevant sources: ggml/src/ggml-cuda/mmq.cuh, mmq.cu, vecdotq.cuh, template-instances/mmq-instance-iq4_xs.cu. Correctness smoke (run by the planner): test-backend-ops -o MUL_MAT and MUL_MAT_ID with type_a=iq4_xs.
